summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on the Sony α 350 (DSLR-A350), a digital single-lens reflex camera marketed by Sony. It states that the camera was replaced from 2009 by the similarly specified Sony α 380. The note also says the camera features live view and body-integrated image stabilization.
one_line: Sony's α 350 (DSLR-A350) is a DSLR camera with live view and body-integrated image stabilization, succeeded in 2009 by the α 380.
key_facts: The Sony α 350 is also designated DSLR-A350.
The Sony α 350 is a digital single-lens reflex camera (DSLR).
The Sony α 350 is marketed by Sony.
The Sony α 350 was replaced from 2009 by the similarly specified Sony α 380.
The Sony α 350 features live view.
The Sony α 350 features body-integrated image stabilization.
